# Georgetown Law Library Research Guides

> Comprehensive legal research guides, treatise finders, and tutorials covering U.S. law, foreign and international law, and specialized practice areas.

Georgetown Law Library provides an extensive collection of research guides and educational resources for law students, practitioners, and researchers. The site serves as a central hub for navigating legal research across multiple jurisdictions and substantive practice areas, with dedicated guides for specialized fields like antitrust, bankruptcy, aviation, and alternative dispute resolution.

## Key Topics

- Legal research
- Research guides
- U.S. Law
- Treatise finders
- Legal education
- Research tutorials
- Foreign and international law
- Legal research process
- Specialized practice areas
- Court documents
- Bar exam preparation
- Georgetown Law Library
- Getting started resources
- Legal research guides
- Law school resources

## Core Research Guides & Navigation

- [Homepage](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu): Main entry point for Georgetown Law Library research guides and tutorials
- [U.S. Law Research](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/home/us-law): U.S. Law research guides and legal research process tutorials
- [Foreign & International Law Research](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/home/foreign-law): Foreign and international law research guides and tutorials
- [Legal History Research](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/home/legal-history): Legal history research guides and academic resources

## Learning Resources & Tools

- [Treatise Finders](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/home/treatise-finders): Treatise finders for legal research and legal education
- [Tutorials](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/home/tutorials): Legal research tutorials and educational resources
- [Bar Exam Resources](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/barexam): Bar exam preparation resources and library guides

## Substantive Law Practice Areas

- [Alternative Dispute Resolution and Mediation](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/adr_mediation): Alternative dispute resolution and mediation research guide
- [Antitrust Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/antitrustlaw): Antitrust law research guide for legal research
- [Bankruptcy Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/bankruptcy): Bankruptcy law research guide with introductory resources
- [Commercial Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/commerciallaw): Commercial law research guide with introduction
- [Banking Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/bankinglaw): Banking law research guide for legal research
- [Aviation Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/aviationlaw): Aviation law research guide for legal research
- [Communications Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/communications): Communications law research guide for legal research
- [Art Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/artlaw): Art law research guide with introduction and getting started

## Specialized Research Topics

- [Animal Law](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/AnimalLaw): Animal law research guide with getting started resources
- [Briefs, Dockets, Oral Arguments and Court Documents](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/briefs_arguments): Court documents research guide including briefs and oral arguments
- [Complementary, Integrative, and Alternative Medicine](https://guides.ll.georgetown.edu/camedicine): Alternative medicine law research guide with introduction
